job_description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated, commercially minded Demand Partnerships Lead to manage and grow Netflix's demand partnerships across the US and Canada. This person will own the day-to-day management of our DSP partners to expand our programmatic footprint. The ideal candidate has a strong background in ad tech, with hands-on expertise in programmatic advertising and a track record of owning revenue-driving partner relationships. This role blends commercial execution with analytical thinking to build and sustain partnerships that deliver measurable business value.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the ongoing management of Netflix's current DSP partners in UCAN - serving as the primary point of contact, driving partner strategy and performance, and deepening the relationship over time.
  • Develop Joint Business Plans with partners and manage the financial performance of commercialization and go-to-market efforts; contribute to ROI models; track spend and returns; and ensure initiatives are structured for sustainable value creation.
